reviewer: Codex: authored localized course and substantive synthetic output review
review_scope: Read all five localized outlines and mandates, both allocation CSVs and actual native schedules/dossiers. Synthetic host interpretations and exact-version approvals live only in regression fixtures. Italian native dossier captions and stable field keys are explained in the lesson language; no engine translation, live voice, learner participation, legal correctness or professional acceptance is claimed. Separate same-engagement continuation preserves byte-identical prior run outputs. No source selection or legal qualification is established by these arithmetic checks.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: Request a versioned Italian OIC partial proportional demerger into a new beneficiary, prepare a first unapproved dossier, review actual assumptions and read separate allocation/ownership schedules.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Read the localized fictional Arco mandate and two-row CSV. Anna/Bruno own 60/40; the machine and loan distinguish book, tax and economic values. Missing lease, unexamined contingent liabilities and null shareholder tax costs are explicit. No pre-approved case or answer ships.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The actual current runner starts without approvals and blocks approval of a perimeter dependent on unknown facts. Test-only confirmations enable the bounded calculation; the dossier stays partial. Checkpoints occur at the missing-evidence review and the actual separate-value schedule. Ordinary learner choices remain natural-language decisions.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: Open the actual review.html/review.md, ownership_before_after.json and allocations.json. Versioned revision, artifact hashes and change impact retain provenance. Mechanical completion does not produce a signature, filing, tax-neutrality conclusion or legal approval.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: Import updated physical evidence in a new local run of the same engagement with the finalized exact prior revision as a genuine upstream artifact. The changed allocation source reopens machine/loan, valuation and calculation; unchanged route and ownership approvals remain. Compare the pre-review changed version with final schedules and retain the original run.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Complete it lesson and input narrative reviewed. Native dossier headings remain Italian and field keys remain stable; the teacher explains them in the selected language. The six-stage outline totals 390 seconds as a pacing target, not a measured learner result. Codex teacher/worker and Cowork written projection remain distinct.

The missing lease and contingencies keep the dossier partial.
